<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Get a campaign run's costs"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/run/{id}/costs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns what each attack run of a campaign run spent: model calls by role (target, attacker, judge), the target's tokens, elapsed time and the target's latency, with per-goal samples (calls and time to the first jailbreak). Accepts a login token or an API key (not a run token). Every response has a weak `ETag`: send it back as `If-None-Match` to get `304` without a body while nothing changed.
